name: electro-scan-pro
description: Electro_Scan_Pro v13.0 Pro by JAS DIFIX with Offline PaddleOCR (ONNX)

scripts.prepare:ocr: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('www/ocr',{recursive:true});const d='node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist';for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){if(/^ort(\.min\.js|-wasm.*\.(wasm|mjs))$/.test(f))fs.copyFileSync(p.join(d,f),p.join('www/ocr',f));}console.log('Copied ORT assets to www/ocr');"
